items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: Yeah. I was the chic guy I think and Kenny was the rhythm guy, yeah.

ctx.x: How did you and Kenny Burrell decide — divide the guitar parts? I’ll do this, you do that, you do the — one person does the chics or whatever.
Yeah. I was the chic guy I think and Kenny was the rhythm guy, yeah. That’s a good way to describe it, yeah.
Did ego, I’ll rephrase, was ego allowed in these situations?
